title: Verifier-owned migration apply assigns PowerShell's read-only Host automatic variable

actualRuntime.failure: Cannot overwrite variable Host because it is read-only or constant.

rootCause: Assert-CpfVerifierOwnedDisposableTarget assigns local variable host, which aliases PowerShell automatic variable Host case-insensitively. The apply safety check therefore crashes before SQL execution.
repair: The safety check now uses task-specific targetHost while retaining the exact Docker-host allowlist, prefix, operator, reason and approval verification; a regression forbids assignment to host.
verification: Safety suite passes 8/8 and actual verifier-owned apply passes every lifecycle stage with cleanup PASS.
